action->Empathy Link.name: Empathy Link
action->Empathy Link.description: An alchemical drudge no puede hablar, but its mind is linked to its creator. It can share basic emotional information with its creator, such as fear, happiness, or anger. If the drudge is destroyed, its maestro automatically knows this. The range of this link is 1,500 pies.

action->Alchemical Strike.name: Alchemical Golpe
action->Alchemical Strike.description:
An alchemical drudge contains a special reservoir that can be loaded with the contents of one alchemical bomb that deals acid, cold, electricity, or daño de fuego, allowing the drudge to imbue its fist attacks with this daño. Each hit deals 1d6 points of daño of the same type as that of the bomb loaded into it. Each bomb has enough fluid in it for 10 successful strikes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.yrenENpzVgBKsnNi]{Efecto: Alchemical Golpe}

action->Vomit Alchemy.name: Vomit Alchemy
action->Vomit Alchemy.description: An alchemical drudge can vomit forth a pool of caustic alchemical reagents, filling the ground in one square adjacent to the drudge. Las criaturas in that square when the pool is created take @Damage[2d6[acid]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]). Any criatura that ends its turn in a square containing a pool takes @Damage[2d6[acid]] daño. The pool remains for 1 minuto before becoming inert.

action->Beestings.name: Beestings
action->Beestings.description: The criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16|traits:damaging-effect] salvación. Those who fail take @Damage[1d4[poison]] daño and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minuto.

action->Swarming Stings.name: Swarming Stings
action->Swarming Stings.description:
Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[1d4[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] salvación). The first time each round a criatura fails the save and takes daño perforante, it also suffers the effect of beestings.

Siempre que the bee swarm uses this ability, the swarm takes 1 daño.

Blood Ooze.name: Cieno de sangre
Blood Ooze.publicNotes:
Swelling like a bubble about to burst, this oozing thing looks like it is made entirely from blood. Its slick, crimson skin is marred only by spots that look like clots formed on the surface.

Created through the foulest of alchemical rituals, the blood ooze seeks only one thing: to increase its mass by consuming blood from the living. The blood ooze hides within the body of its victims, only bursting out to attack when another meal draws near, leaving the body a husk of its former self.

The process by which such an ooze is created involves draining the blood of at least four Medium criaturas and feeding all of the collected blood to a fifth criatura, along with deadly reagents designed to prevent the blood from coagulating. During this time, the host slowly dies while the blood ooze takes form, emerging 2 to 6 hours later. Blood oozes have no loyalty toward those who created them, but some creators have noted that newly formed blood oozes seem to avoid harming other members of the host criatura's family.

It is not widely known that an existing blood ooze can reproduce by splitting itself in half. It undergoes this division only if it has grown so large that splitting in half would create a pair of normal-sized blood oozes, such as the one listed below.

action->Infuse Corpse.name: Infuse Corpse
action->Infuse Corpse.description: A blood ooze can seep into a corpse's wounds, displacing its natural blood. It can burst out of the corpse as a free action.

action->Motion Sense 60 feet.name: Motion Sense 60 pies
action->Motion Sense 60 feet.description: A blood ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

action->Blood Pool.name: Blood Pool
action->Blood Pool.description: Siempre que a criatura adjacent to a blood ooze takes daño de sangrado, the blood ooze regains an amount of Puntos de golpe equal to the daño dealt.

action->Clot.name: Clot
action->Clot.description:
Desencadenante The blood ooze is damaged by a piercing or slashing attack.

Efecto The blood ooze forms a clot around the wound, reducing the daño taken by 5 (to a minimum of 0).

action->Siphon Vitality.name: Siphon Vitality
action->Siphon Vitality.description:
The blood ooze draws forth blood from nearby criaturas, causing their flesh to break open and blood to spill out which replenishes the blood ooze. Each living criatura within @Template[emanation|distance:15]{15 pies} takes @Damage[3d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

The blood ooze regains an amount of Puntos de golpe equal to half the daño Siphon Vitality dealt to the single criatura that took the most daño.

Bloodlash Bush.name: Arbusto azotesangre
Bloodlash Bush.publicNotes:
The bloodlash bush attempts to lacerate its foes, using its weeping wounds to irrigate the ground around itself. The seeds of a bloodlash bush can take root only in soil that has been soaked in blood.

Often overlooked in light of more obvious threats, some plants can be just as deadly and dangerous as wild beasts.

What first appears to be a simple shrub suddenly stirs to life.

action->Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 pies

action->Blood Siphon.name: Blood Siphon
action->Blood Siphon.description:
The tendrils of the bush reach out to siphon the blood from a victim up to 20 pies away with daño persistente de sangrado, causing the victim to immediately take that amount of daño de sangrado (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]).

The bush regains an amount of Puntos de golpe equal to double the daño dealt.

action->Spinning Strike.name: Spinning Golpe
action->Spinning Strike.description: The bush spins in a circle, lashing out in all directions at once. It makes one tirada de ataque and compares the result to the AC of each criatura within its melee reach, rolling daño only once and applying it to each criatura hit.

action->Weeping Wounds.name: Weeping Wounds
action->Weeping Wounds.description:
A bloodlash bush's vines cause terrible lacerations that continue to bleed. A criatura hit with a vine attack takes @Damage[1[bleed]] daño (@Damage[2[bleed]] daño on a impacto crítico).

Unlike other forms of daño persistente, this daño is cumulative, to a maximum of 5 daño persistente de sangrado but it can be stopped like any other daño persistente de sangrado.

action->Acid Breath.name: Acid Breath
action->Acid Breath.description:
The wolf unleashes a stream of bright green acid from its mouth, coating all criaturas in a @Template[line|distance:30]. All criaturas in the line take @Damage[3d6[acid]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

The caustic wolf cannot use this ability again for 1 minuto.

action->Howl.name: Howl
action->Howl.description:
The wolf unleashes a terrifying howl, allowing it to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{DEMORALIZE} all enemies within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies}. Wolves within @Template[emanation|distance:100]{100 pies} can spend a reaction to join the howl, causing the effect to emanate from them as well. Este affects additional enemies within 30 pies of them and uses the caustic wolf's INTIMIDATION check with a -4 penalizador por circunstancia.

Enemies cannot be affected by the howl more than once, even if they are near more than one howling wolf. All criaturas targeted by this effect are temporarily immune for 24 horas.

armor->Durable Farm Clothes.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]

armor->Durable Farm Clothes.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zBYEU9E7034ENCmh]

Este armor is simply a layer of heavy, quilted cloth, but it is sometimes used because it's so inexpensive. Padded armor is easier to daño and destroy than other types of armor. Heavy armor comes with a padded armor undercoat included in its Price, though it loses the comfort rasgo when worn under heavy armor. Puedes wear just that padded armor or undercoat to sleep in, if tu heavy armor is destroyed, or when otherwise not wearing the full heavy armor. Este allows tú to keep the armor invested and benefit from the power of any runes on the associated heavy armor, but no one else can wear tu heavy armor without the padded undercoat.

Falling Debris.name: Escombros que caen
Falling Debris.description: A pressure-sensitive floorboard connects to a beam holding up debris in the crawlway's ceiling.
Falling Debris.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:15|name:Disable Trap|traits:mechanical,trap,hazard] (entrenado) on the floorboard before the debris falls

action->Falling Debris.name: Escombros que caen
action->Falling Debris.description:
Desencadenante Pressure is placed on the floorboard.

Efecto The ceiling in the crawlway collapses in the square where the passage turns, and also in the two adjacent squares. Anyone in these three squares takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]] daño and can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:14|traits:damaging-effect] salvación to reduce the daño. For the criatura in the center square, where the trap is triggered, this is a basic save. Las criaturas in the two adjacent squares take no daño on a success or critical success as they avoid the falling debris entirely, but take full daño on a failed save, and take double daño on a critical failure. Las criaturas that take daño from the debris are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, trapped under the crushing weight.

Clearing out a square of debris requires a successful @Check[athletics|dc:17|name:Clear Debris] prueba de habilidad, with the following effects.

Éxito crítico The square is cleared in 1 minuto.

Éxito The square is cleared in 5 minutes.

Fallo The square is cleared in 10 minutos.

Fallo crítico The ceiling above the square collapses further, dealing an additional @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] daño to the character digging out the square and any character trapped in that square. Este takes 1 minuto and no progress is made.

action->Fiery Pelt.name: Fiery Pelt
action->Fiery Pelt.description: Las criaturas that start their turn grappled by a fiery leopard take @Damage[1d4[fire]] daño. Anyone attempting to grapple a fiery leopard takes @Damage[1d4[fire]] daño for each attempt.

Efecto A freezing alchemical slurry is dumped into the room, dealing @Damage[4d6[cold]] daño to everyone in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] salvación).

action->Icy Death.name: Icy Death
action->Icy Death.description: When an icy rat is slain, its body explodes in a burst of frozen fur and bone, dealing @Damage[2d4[cold]] daño to all adjacent criaturas (@Check[reflex|dc:14|basic] salvación).

action->No Escape.name: Sin Huida Posible
action->No Escape.description:
Desencadenante An adjacent foe moves away.

Efecto Lord Nar may move up to his speed but must end his move as close to the triggering criatura as possible without entering the triggering criatura's square.

action->Rage.name: Furia
action->Rage.description:
Lord Nar flies into a rage that lasts 1 minuto and grants him 8 Puntos de golpe temporales, 4 daño adicional with his listed attacks, and a -1 penalizador to AC.

He cannot use actions that have the concentrate rasgo while raging, unless they also have the rage rasgo.

Once his rage ends, Nar cannot Rage again for 1 minuto.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Efecto: Rage}

action->Fleas.name: Fleas
action->Fleas.description: Anyone bitten by a mangy wolf is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 minuto unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:14] salvación, but they can spend an INTERACT action to scratch away the fleas and remove the condition.

action->Motion Sense (Precise) 30 feet.description: A mutant wolf can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

action->Gore Spray.description:
Desencadenante A criatura critically hits a mutant wolf while adjacent to it.

Efecto The wound causes gore to spray from a ruptured pustule. The triggering criatura takes @Damage[3d6[acid]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] salvación). Este occurs even if the attack kills the wolf.

action->Tear.name: Tear

action->Many Minds.description: The Amalgam has many consciousnesses floating inside its mind, and they are not equally affected by mental magic. The Amalgam always treats its tiradas de salvación against mental effects as one degree better.

action->Too Many Limbs.name: Too Many Limbs
action->Too Many Limbs.description: The amalgam can make up to four Golpes, one with each of its listed melee attacks, but no more than two at any one target. It takes a -2 penalizador to each attack, but the multiple attack penalizador does not increase until all the attacks are made.

action->Massive Strike.name: Massive Golpe
action->Massive Strike.description: The behemoth makes a melee Golpe and, if the attack hits, it can push the criatura back 10 pies (20 pies on a impacto crítico). action->Stomp.name: Stomp

On a impacto crítico, a criatura in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 asalto, and a criatura flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 asalto. Tanglefoot bags are not effective when used on a criatura that is in water.

El objetivo can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. Estos INTERACT actions don't have to be consecutive, and other criaturas can provide the actions as well.

action->Light Hold.description:
A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a vine lasher is not immobilized, but the grabbed criatura's space and every adjacent square use the rules for difficult terrain.
